name: airbnb-search
description: Search Airbnb listings with advanced filtering and get detailed property information
long_description: A comprehensive MCP Bundle for searching Airbnb listings with various filters including location, dates, guest count, price range, and more. Get detailed information about specific properties including amenities, policies, location details, and highlights. Respects robots.txt by default with option to override for testing purposes.

tools.name: airbnb_search
tools.description: Search for Airbnb listings with various filters including location, dates, guests, and price range. Returns paginated results with direct links.

tools.name: airbnb_listing_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Airbnb listing including amenities, policies, location details, and highlights.

tools.name: airbnb_trip_search
tools.description: Plan and rank Airbnb stays from a destination or wishlist with dated availability and best-available pre-submit pricing.

airbnb_browser_helper.title: Trip planner Airbnb helper
airbnb_browser_helper.description: Path to the ecosystem trip-planner Airbnb CDP helper.

airbnb_cdp_url.title: Airbnb Chrome debugging URL
airbnb_cdp_url.description: Loopback URL for the dedicated authenticated Airbnb Chrome profile.

ignore_robots_txt.title: Ignore robots.txt
ignore_robots_txt.description: Bypass Airbnb robots.txt restrictions. Disabled by default.

disable_geocoding.title: Disable third-party geocoding
disable_geocoding.description: Skip the Photon/Nominatim geocoding step and let Airbnb resolve location strings on its own. Eliminates third-party outbound calls but causes non-US searches (e.g. 'Paris, France') to return wrong results.
